comments.body:
You can look into Hautes écoles spécialisées (HES). Depending on the field you're interested in there's Bachelor and Master degree.
In Romandie a lot of student of HES tried EPFL before. 
I'm not saying it's second zone education, far from that. I'd say it's more applied knowledge than theoretical knowledge.
It's a different approach of a field :)
comments.author: dayanadaway
